errors.evidence: The chart and legend show six banks (Райфайзен банк, Алианц Банк България, Ти Би Ай Банк, ПроКредит Банк, БАКБ, Токуда), not five.
There are six lines on the chart, corresponding to the six banks in the legend, not five.
The green line for Райфайзен банк starts at exactly 10% in 2008, not 12%.
The line for Алианц Банк България is orange, not brown.
The line for Алианц Банк България starts at approximately 9% in 2008, not 8%.
The word 'движително' is awkward and unclear in this context. A better phrasing would be 'остава стабилна' (remains stable).
The repetition 'сиво-сиво' (grey-grey) is awkward. Simply stating 'сива' (grey) is sufficient and clearer.
The grey line for Ти Би Ай Банк starts at approximately 14.5% in 2008, which is closer to 15% than 13%.

errors.evidence: For Ти Би Ай Банк, the line drops to about 17-18% in 2012. It drops to 12% in 2013, not 2012.

errors.evidence: The line for Ти Би Ай Банк stabilizes in a range between approximately 22% and 24%, not 20% and 23%.

errors.evidence: The line for ПроКредит Банк peaks at approximately 13% in 2010, not 12%.
The light blue line for БАКБ starts at approximately 23% in 2008, not 22%.

errors.evidence: This description for Токуда bank is incorrect. The line starts at ~11% (not 10%), does not rise to 12% in 2010, and remains relatively stable between 10% and 11.5% throughout the period. The provided description incorrectly mimics the trend of a different bank (ПроКредит Банк).
